info.name: Movie Review Platform - Assessment 2 (all new endpoints)
info.description: API tests for every new Assessment 2 endpoint: notifications and review ranking (MRP-57), movie comparison (MRP-55), admin statistics and health (MRP-56). Run the collection top to bottom (Collection Runner). Each request name carries its requirement ID or Jira key. Needs an admin account: set adminEmail and adminPassword in the environment.

item.name: 0. Setup
item.description: Creates two reviewers, logs in the admin, creates a movie and submits two reviews. Run the whole collection top to bottom.

request.description: Needs a real admin account. Set adminEmail and adminPassword in the environment (create one with `npm run seed:admin` in the backend).

exec: pm.test('Account is an admin', function () { pm.expect(body.role).to.equal('admin'); });

item.name: Admin creates a second movie (used by the comparison tests)
1. Notifications (MRP-57)
item.description: FR-N1, FR-N2, FR-N3, NFR-N1. Observer pattern: moderating a review emits an event and a listener stores the notification.

item.name: [FR-N1 | MRP-92] Admin approves reviewer A's review
[FR-N1 | MRP-92] Reviewer A receives an approval notification

exec: // The notification is created just after the response, so wait briefly before reading it.

pm.test('It is an approval naming the movie', function () { pm.expect(body.notifications[0].type).to.equal('review_approved'); pm.expect(body.notifications[0].message).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('movieTitle')); });

item.name: [FR-N3 | MRP-101] Another user cannot mark it read (403)
Reviewer A submits review 2 (to be rejected)
[FR-N1 | MRP-92] Rejection without a long enough reason (400)
[FR-N1 | MRP-92] Admin rejects the review with a reason
[FR-N1 | MRP-92] Reviewer A receives a rejection notification with the reason

exec: // The notification is created just after the response, so wait briefly before reading it.
pm.test('One new unread notification', function () { pm.expect(body.unreadCount).to.equal(1); });

pm.test('It is a rejection that includes the reason', function () { pm.expect(body.notifications[0].type).to.equal('review_rejected'); pm.expect(body.notifications[0].message).to.include('Not constructive enough'); });

item.name: [FR-N1 | MRP-92] Re-moderating a decided review is refused (409)
[FR-N3 | MRP-101] Mark all notifications as read
[FR-N3 | MRP-101] Unread count is 0 after read-all

exec: pm.test('Both notifications are kept, newest first', function () { pm.expect(body.notifications.length).to.equal(2); pm.expect(body.notifications[0].type).to.equal('review_rejected'); });

item.name: 2. Review ranking (MRP-57)
item.description: FR-R1, FR-R2, NFR-R2. Strategy pattern: ?sort= picks one ordering class.

item.name: [FR-R1 | MRP-103] Reviewer B marks A's review helpful
[FR-R1 | MRP-103] Clicking again removes the vote
[FR-R1 | MRP-103] Vote again (kept for the sorting checks)
[NFR-R2 | MRP-106] Author cannot vote on their own review (403)
Reviewer A submits review 3 (stays Pending, setup)
[FR-R1 | MRP-103] Cannot vote on a Pending review (409)
[FR-R2 | MRP-104] No sort given defaults to newest

exec: pm.test('Defaults to newest first', function () { pm.expect(ratings).to.eql([3, 5]); });

item.name: [FR-R2 | MRP-104] Unknown sort value falls back to newest

exec: pm.test('Falls back to newest first', function () { pm.expect(ratings).to.eql([3, 5]); });

item.name: [FR-R2 | MRP-104] Only approved reviews are listed

exec: pm.test('Two approved reviews (rejected and pending are hidden)', function () { pm.expect(body.reviews.length).to.equal(2); body.reviews.forEach(function (r) { pm.expect(r.status).to.equal('Approved'); }); });

item.name: [NFR-R2 | MRP-106] Voter ids are never exposed publicly

exec: pm.test('No helpfulVoters field, helpfulCount is a number', function () { body.reviews.forEach(function (r) { pm.expect(r).to.not.have.property('helpfulVoters'); pm.expect(r.helpfulCount).to.be.a('number'); }); });

item.name: 3. Movie comparison (MRP-55: MRP-58, MRP-59)
item.description: GET /api/movies/compare. Builder pattern builds each movie's comparison object.

exec: pm.test('Returns two movies in the order requested', function () { pm.expect(body.movies.length).to.equal(2); pm.expect(body.movies[0].id).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('movieId')); pm.expect(body.movies[1].id).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('movieId2')); });
pm.test('First movie has 2 approved reviews averaging 4', function () { pm.expect(body.movies[0].approvedReviewCount).to.equal(2); pm.expect(body.movies[0].averageRating).to.equal(4); });
pm.test('Second movie has no reviews, so a null average', function () { pm.expect(body.movies[1].approvedReviewCount).to.equal(0); pm.expect(body.movies[1].averageRating).to.equal(null); });

item.name: 4. Admin statistics and health (MRP-56: MRP-125, MRP-133)
item.description: GET /api/admin/stats (admin only, Facade pattern) and GET /api/health (load balancer health check).

item.name: [MRP-133] Health check reports ok and database connected

exec: pm.test('ok, with instance name and database status', function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.equal('ok'); pm.expect(body.database).to.equal('connected'); pm.expect(body.instance).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Review counts add up', function () { pm.expect(body.reviews.total).to.equal(body.reviews.pending + body.reviews.approved + body.reviews.rejected); });

pm.test('Counts reflect this run (2 approved, 1 rejected, 1 pending at least)', function () { pm.expect(body.reviews.approved).to.be.at.least(2); pm.expect(body.reviews.rejected).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(body.reviews.pending).to.be.at.least(1); });
pm.test('Movie and reviewer totals are numbers', function () { pm.expect(body.movies.total).to.be.at.least(2); pm.expect(body.reviewers.total).to.be.at.least(2); });

pm.test('Top rated is at most 5 movies, highest average first', function () { pm.expect(body.topRated.length).to.be.at.most(5); for (var i = 1; i < body.topRated.length; i++) { pm.expect(body.topRated[i - 1].avgRating).to.be.at.least(body.topRated[i].avgRating); } });
